fields: CLOSE (or single value column for some indices)
cboe_indices.notes: https://cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/{SYM}_History.csv. VIX/VIX9D/VIX3M/VIX6M/VIX1Y/VIX1D/SKEW/VVIX/VXN/RVX/VXD/OVX/GVZ/VXEEM/VXTLT/VXEFA/single-stock VIX + strategy indices PUT/BXM/BXMD/BXY/CNDR/BFLY/CLL/PPUT/PUTY/BXMW/CMBO/RXM, COR1M/COR3M, DSPX, VXTH, SPX/OEX/XEO/DJX/RUT. Early rows of some files have O=H=L=C (close only). SKEW/VVIX/PUT etc. have single value column. Dates MM/DD/YYYY. VXST, VXV, COR9D, SPXEW, NDX returned 403.

fred.notes: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=SERIES. Percent units. Missing values are empty strings (holidays). NOTE: FRED rejected a custom User-Agent (HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR / empty reply) but served the default curl UA. BAML* series only return last 3y (ICE license). FRED data are revised; for PIT use ALFRED vintages.

ken_french.notes: https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/ftp/<name>.zip. Percent returns. Files contain multiple sub-tables (value-weighted, equal-weighted, annual) separated by text lines; -99.99/-999 = missing. RF is 1-month T-bill.

yfinance_daily.adjusted: split-adjusted OHLC (Yahoo always split-adjusts), NOT dividend-adjusted; Adj Close = split+dividend adjusted
yfinance_daily.notes: yfinance 1.7.0, Ticker.history(period=max, auto_adjust=False, actions=True). Raw unadjusted prices must be reconstructed by multiplying by cumulative split factors. Live ETFs only (no delisted). Yahoo ToS: personal use.

yfinance_intraday_1m.notes: 1-minute bars incl. pre/post (04:00-20:00 ET), last 7 days only (Yahoo keeps ~30 days of 1m). Extended-hours volume often 0/partial.

yfinance_options_snapshot.notes: Current snapshot only (no history from Yahoo). Taken outside market hours so bid/ask may be 0/stale.

qlib_us_1d.notes: Microsoft Qlib community US dataset (GitHub release SunsetWolf/qlib_dataset v2, 450MB). Binary .day.bin: float32 little-endian, first value = start index into calendars/day.txt. Prices are adjusted AND normalized (first close=1); raw price = value/factor. Source Yahoo. Instruments: all.txt (8994 incl. ETFs like SPY/QQQ/TQQQ/XLK), sp500.txt (755 rows w/ membership intervals), nasdaq100.txt. Only 178 symbols end before 2020-11-10 -> largely survivorship-biased. Ends 2020-11-10.

symbols.volatility_history (remote): IV/HV current, week/month ago, 52w hi/lo per symbol per day

dolthub_post_no_preference.adjusted: unknown (ohlcv appears unadjusted daily; dividends/splits separate)
dolthub_post_no_preference.notes: DoltHub SQL API https://www.dolthub.com/api/v1alpha1/post-no-preference/{options|earnings|stocks|rates}/master?q=SQL (max 1000 rows/query, ~20-60s timeout; aggregates on big tables time out -> filter on PK date first). Whole-table CSV: https://www.dolthub.com/csv/post-no-preference/<repo>/master/<table> (works for small tables; stocks.symbol timed out 504). For bulk use `dolt clone post-no-preference/<repo>`. earnings_calendar.when: After market close 50,915 / Before market open 39,487 / NULL 31,711.

hf_ziplime_earnings_calendar.notes: HF dataset ZipLime/earnings-calendar (Apache-2.0) rev f8d9be6. 8-K Item 2.02 earnings releases with EDGAR acceptance time from SGML header (ET), session pre_market/market_hours/after_close, first_tradeable_session (NYSE calendar), EPS/revenue from XBRL, SUE. events/ = all 8-K items (4.38M rows, 1993-2026). Card warns EDGAR submissions JSON acceptanceDateTime "Z" is actually Eastern for a large share of pre-2021 filings.

sec_edgar.notes: data.sec.gov works with UA "atlasbt-research/0.1" (no email). www.sec.gov (company_tickers.json, Archives full-index) returned 403 without a contact email in UA - SEC policy requires "Name email" UA; DATA agent should use a declared UA (confirm email with the user). Rate limit 10 req/s. 8-K Item 2.02 rows carry acceptanceDateTime (see ZipLime caveat on time zone).

fields: bill rates: bank discount + coupon equivalent for 4/8/13/17/26/52 wk
us_treasury.notes: https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/daily-treasury-rates.csv/{YEAR}/all?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve|daily_treasury_bill_rates&field_tdr_date_value={YEAR}&_format=csv (one year per call; yield curve since 1990, bill rates since 2002). XML: .../pages/xml?data=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value=YYYY.

global_q_factors.notes: Hou-Xue-Zhang q5 factors, daily + monthly (2025 vintage), percent. https://global-q.org/uploads/1/2/2/6/122679606/q5_factors_{daily|monthly}_2025.csv

fields: per-sheet: DATE + one column per country incl. USA
aqr_factors.notes: AQR data sets (https://www.aqr.com/-/media/AQR/Documents/Insights/Data-Sets/<name>.xlsx). Daily BAB/QMJ/HML-Devil files contain MKT, SMB, HML FF, HML Devil, UMD, BAB/QMJ, RF sheets. AQR terms: research use, attribution.

wikipedia_sp_index_pages.notes: en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=...&action=render|raw (REST /api/rest_v1 returned 429 for our UA). Changes table rows: 412; coverage is sparse before ~2000. CC BY-SA.

gh_datasets_finance-vix.notes: git clone https://github.com/datasets/finance-vix (ODC-PDDL). VIX daily OHLC 1990.. (mirror of Cboe)

gh_datasets_s-and-p-500.notes: git clone https://github.com/datasets/s-and-p-500 (ODC-PDDL). Shiller monthly S&P composite, dividends, earnings, CPI, long rate

gh_datasets_s-and-p-500-companies.notes: git clone https://github.com/datasets/s-and-p-500-companies (ODC-PDDL). current S&P 500 list w/ GICS sector

gh_datasets_s-and-p-500-companies-financ.notes: git clone https://github.com/datasets/s-and-p-500-companies-financials (ODC-PDDL). current snapshot of S&P500 financial ratios

fields: tick bi5: uint32 ms-from-hour, uint32 ask, uint32 bid, float32 askvol, float32 bidvol (big-endian, LZMA)
candle bi5: uint32 sec-from-day, O, C, L, H (uint32), float32 vol
dukascopy.notes: https://datafeed.dukascopy.com/datafeed/{INSTR}/{YYYY}/{MM-1 zero-based}/{DD}/{HH}h_ticks.bi5 and .../{BID|ASK}_candles_min_1.bi5. Prices /1000 for US stock CFDs (SPY 474.513). These are Dukascopy CFD quotes, NOT exchange NBBO; US stock CFDs quote ~RTH only. Server rate-limits (503) and times out frequently: pace >=2s, retry. 4 of 27 hour files failed in sample.

fields: pcapng of IEX-TP 1.6 TOPS: QuoteUpdate(Q): ts ns, symbol, bid size/px, ask px/size; TradeReport(T); etc.
iex_hist.notes: IEX HIST (free, IEX Exchange terms with attribution). Index: https://iextrading.com/api/1.0/hist (2,498 dates 2016-12-12..2026-10-27; TOPS 1.5/1.6, DEEP since 2017-05-15, DPLS since 2024-10-01). Files on GCS bucket "iex" (storage.googleapis.com). Typical recent day 10-16 GB per feed; 2019-12-24 half-day TOPS = 160 MB. IEX-only quotes/trades (not consolidated NBBO). Verified SPY quote 2019-12-24 13:34:55 bid 2000@321.55.

SPX/SPXW Dec-2023 CSV samples were not downloadable (Dropbox served HTML).
